item.title: Ex Ōre Equī · Diēs Sāturnī, a.d. XVIII Kal. Dec. (Sat 14 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra: 13–28°, partly cloudy, showers very likely (90%), thunderstorm chance this afternoon; 13–27° and showers tomorrow. Australia: Bowen pushes a pragmatic deal at COP31; two months after Tony Burke announced cuts to backpacker visas (second-year cap 45,000 from 57,000, third-year 5,000 from 31,000, a ballot), the Government considers a backdown after an outcry from farms and hospitality; The Australian: the ballot may be delayed and third-year visas lifted to 25,000; Burke: 'Those conversations are continuing'; Grattan (The Conversation): the government is in trouble. Iran: Iran tells the IAEA no monitoring talks under 'persistent, explicit, and public threats by the President'; Trump: 'No, without hesitation'; IRGC claims a US radar in Bahrain, CENTCOM: two drones shot down, no damage; more tankers hit in Hormuz (some by mines); Brent about $96; Bessent moves to a military base. US: Poland's defence minister says the Pentagon has green-lit a permanent US troop presence, White House decision in early December. Ukraine: Zelensky meets Witkoff and Kushner at Casement Aerodrome, Baldonnel: 'a real result', the biggest POW exchange; Kushner: no deal 'without the Europeans being at the table'; Europeans at next week's talks. Good news: retired teacher Tricia Johnson has sent care packages to 176 former students. Opīniō: The Spectator Australia leader 'Dismissal 2.0'. Justinian died 14 Nov 565. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (13 Nov, citing The Australian); Fox News, Jerusalem Post, Democracy Now, Just Security (13 Nov); TheJournal.ie, Irish Times/PA, Kyiv Independent (12 Nov); Only Good News Daily (13 Nov); The Spectator Australia; Christian History Institute; History Today.

item.title: Ex Ōre Equī · Diēs Veneris, Īd. Nov. (Fri 13 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra: 11–30°, partly cloudy, showers and a thunderstorm chance this afternoon; 14–28° and showers tomorrow. Australia: Albanese at COP31 in Antalya: 'real and rapid progress is possible', no mention of 'fossil fuels'; warnings that power prices could nearly double by 2029 as coal plants close; McKenzie: 'Chris Bowen is living in an alternative reality'; O'Neil: 'We have to move towards renewables'. Iran: Trump: 'We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed'; Vance told to focus on crime and corruption in Democrat-run cities; Rezaei: talk of talks in Qatar 'a pure lie', Hormuz shut until the seven conditions are met. US: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier guard Spc. Thomas Iglesias reprimands Hegseth's group; Pentagon backs him; Hegseth awards him the Joint Service Commendation Medal. Ukraine: large prisoner exchange agreed after Abu Dhabi; Witkoff and Kushner meet Putin in the Kremlin, Zelensky next. Good news: Maple the puppy home from the Middle East (Paws of War). Opīniō: Rusty Weiss (RedState): America 'no longer needs to bargain' with Iran. St Augustine born at Thagaste, 13 Nov 354. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; RenewEconomy, Yahoo/7News, Yeni Şafak (11 Nov); The Nightly (11 Nov); Reuters (12 Nov); Al Jazeera (11–12 Nov); AP (12 Nov); ABC News (12 Nov); Censor.NET (12 Nov); WCBD (10 Nov); RedState (12 Nov); Britannica.

item.title: Ex Ōre Equī · Diēs Iovis, prīd. Īd. Nov. (Thu 12 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra: 10–27°, early fog then mostly sunny; 11–30° and a storm chance tomorrow; Brisbane storms, 31°. Australia: new home loans fall 15.5% in the September quarter, the biggest fall on record; investor lending down 32.3% (J.P. Morgan: budget tax changes); David Jones to close 19 stores; CBA quarterly profit A$2.8bn, Comyn on pressure from inflation and rates; Iran: Rubio: 'no need for major combat operations', Iran's demands 'totally unrealistic'; Trump: new strikes 'quite unlikely'; Rezaei: not 'a single particle' of enriched material will leave Iran. US: House votes 211–204 to send Massie's Hegseth impeachment articles back to committee; 11 Democrats absent; Trump: 'miserably FAILED!'. Ukraine: Abu Dhabi talks end after two days with no breakthrough; prisoner swap of 1,000 for 1,000 discussed. Kentucky: six-year-old Roman Heilman found alive by a trail rider after three days. Opīniō: Michael de Percy, Albanese is 'sleepwalking Australia into systemic poverty'. St Josaphat, killed in Vitebsk, 12 Nov 1623. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (11 Nov); The Spectator Australia (Michael de Percy, 10 Nov); Al Jazeera (11 Nov); The Week (10 Nov); Just Security (11 Nov); The Moscow Times, Kyiv Post, AP, Reuters (11 Nov); Good News Network (10 Nov); Wikipedia.

item.title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Mercuriī, III Īd. Nov. (Wed 11 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra: 9–28°, partly cloudy, afternoon storm chance; 11–27° and morning fog tomorrow; Brisbane storms, 31°. Australia: Albanese flies to COP31 in Turkey on a two-week trip; Taylor: 'this government has wrecked the economy'; Charlton backs Chalmers; Newspoll: One Nation 28%, Labor 27%. Iran: Trump: Iran 'militarily, is effectively over' but America is 'locked and loaded', another carrier heads east; Rezaei: 'surrender to Iran's seven conditions'. US: House votes on Massie's Hegseth impeachment resolution; Hegseth: 'a political spectacle'. Ukraine: Abu Dhabi talks open, first in nine months; Russia fired 162 drones overnight. Brisbane: rescuer frees a koala joey from a python. Opīniō: Rowan Dean, Trump fought Iran because it was right. St Martin of Tours; Armistice 1918. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; AAP (Canberra Times, Armidale Express, 10 Nov); The Nightly (10 Nov); Israel Hayom, The Week (10 Nov); Fox News (9–10 Nov); ANI (10 Nov); ABC News US (10 Nov); Kyiv Independent (10 Nov); Epoch Times (10 Nov); ABC News (6 Nov); The Spectator Australia (Rowan Dean, 9 Nov).

item.title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Mārtis, IV Īd. Nov. (Tue 10 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra: fog, then 4–25° and mostly sunny; 28° and a chance of storms tomorrow. Australia: inflation 4.3%, Murray Watt tells colleagues to stop leaking against Chalmers, $3bn over-65s rebate cut stuck in the Senate, Resolve: only 20% trust Albanese, Taylor: 'out of touch, out of his depth'. Iran: Trump says Iron Gate is in full force, 'very little gets into, or out of, Iran'; Rubio calls Iran's offer 'outrageous and ridiculous'. US: House may vote to impeach Hegseth this week, Jeffries: 'Hegseth has got to go'; Mississippi postal votes close today. Ukraine: US-brokered talks open in Abu Dhabi after strikes on the grid. Flint, Michigan: newborn deaths halve under Rx Kids. Opīniō: David Flint, 'Australians have given up on Albanese'. Pope Leo the Great died, AD 461. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (9 Nov); The Age/SMH (9 Nov); The National and Al Jazeera (9 Nov); Just Security (9 Nov); Roll Call (9 Nov); Yahoo News (7 Nov); UN News (9 Nov); Reuters (2 Nov); Good Good Good (7 Nov); The Spectator Australia (David Flint, 31 Oct).
